summary: dnf5 options: enable_plugin, enablerepo, exclude, install_weak_deps, installroot, list (prefer package_facts), and lock_timeout which is currently a no-op in dnf5.
questions: Does lock_timeout work with the dnf5 module?
How do I enable a repo just for one dnf5 install?
How do I exclude packages during a dnf5 upgrade?
How do I skip weak dependencies with dnf5?

answer_card.title: dnf5 parameters (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `enablerepo`: per transaction
- `enable_plugin`: needs libdnf5 5.2+; `disable_plugin` wins if both
- `exclude`: list or comma string
- `install_weak_deps` (yes), `installroot` (/)
- `list`: ad-hoc only; prefer `package_facts`
- `lock_timeout`: **no-op** in dnf5
